name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description: NDMF-based texture optimizer for VRChat avatars. Analyzes mesh-UV-to-texture mappings, scales UV islands by perceptual quality metrics (MS-SSIM / CIEDE2000 / alpha / normal-angle / grayscale RMSE), removes unused UV space and repacks islands into atlases. / 基于 NDMF 的 VRChat Avatar 贴图优化工具:分析网格UV到贴图的映射,按感知质量算法缩放UV岛,剔除未用UV并重新装箱图集。
